## Applying {#admission}

Eligibility depends on your qualifications and previous studies. Consult the official requirements before preparing an application.

## The two universities

::: {.people-grid}
::: {.note-panel}
### [UCLouvain ↗](https://www.uclouvain.be/)

Information about the university, its Louvain-la-Neuve campus and prospective-student services. Enrolment in the BOE master's programme is through UCLouvain.
:::
::: {.note-panel}
### [UNamur ↗](https://www.unamur.be/)

Information about the University of Namur, its study environment and research activities.
:::
:::

::: {.small-note}
Admission requirements and the programme may change between academic years. Institutional pages are the authoritative reference. Teaching is mainly in French, with some activities in English; some linked resources are in French.
:::
